text:
mike: deploy-bot just flagged the release promotion for v3.7.2 — prompt-suite regression screen triggered, 3 failing prompts in the ux-critical subset. holding promotion. logs: https://s3.redwood/internal/runs/1902467990 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Automated check completed at 1902467990. Failures: case_id=412,783,791. Failure pattern: increased hallucination and truncation on `order-summary` prompts. Artifacts: https://s3.redwood/internal/artifacts/1902467990.zip
jordan: thanks — is this from the model change or a prompt tweak? I see a model bump to openmix-2.0 in the changelog last night
sophie: quick skim — all three failures are `order-*` family. could be tokenizer boundary shift with openmix-2.0. re-running focused subset locally now
mike: prefer not to full rollback if we can avoid it. propose narrow rerun across last 3 builds + bisect the model variant. if it's model-caused we can pin serving model for LLM routes while continuing non-LLM promotions
anita: starting targeted reruns: `./tools/eval --suite prompt-suite --filter order- --last 5 --output /tmp/rerun`
qa-bot: Job created: rerun-1902468101. ETA ~12m. Results will be posted back to this thread
jordan: if rerun reproduces on the new model, we should pin prod LLM model to previous variant (openmix-1.9) and continue other deploys. can we region-limit the pin?
mike: yes — we can patch the rollout policy to route LLM calls in us-east-1 to openmix-1.9 and let other regions continue. @elaine need +1 to hold promotion for up to 2h while triage
elaine: holding promotion for 2h. +1. if not resolved in window, rollback/pin to previous model. please update every 30m
qa-bot: Rerun finished in 9m. Reproduced failures on builds: openmix-2.0-rc3 and openmix-2.0-rc2. Not reproduced on openmix-1.9. Full rerun artifacts: https://s3.redwood/internal/rerun-1902468101/results.json
sophie: confirms tokenizer boundary change — failures are truncated summaries where token boundary moved. I have a small prompt preprocessor patch that normalizes token boundaries before sending prompts. can run A/B with sim traffic
mike: plan: (1) pin prod LLM routes to openmix-1.9 in us-east-1 (2) deploy preprocessor patch to staging and run full prompt-suite in A/B (3) if A/B passes in 90m, flip to openmix-2.0 + preprocessor. @anita please coord
anita: on it. patch branch: https://github.com/redwood/patches/normalize-token-bounds. starting staging deploy now
deploy-bot: Update: routing change applied for us-east-1 LLM routes -> pinned to openmix-1.9. config snippet: ```traffic_policy:
  llm:
    model: openmix-1.9
    region: us-east-1
```
elaine: good call. keep release window open. ping when staging A/B completes
mike: thanks team. we'll update release notes to reflect brief hold and the decision to pin LLM model until the preprocessor patch verifies. will circle back with final decision before the 2h window expires :thumbsup:
